title: China-to-Egypt Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Egypt regulates power-tool electrical safety through Egyptian Standards (ES) issued by EOS, many of which adopt the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden electric tools. Egypt operates a 220 V, 50 Hz single-phase grid, so plug, insulation, and rated-voltage marking must suit 220 V 50 Hz. The charger or external power supply of a cordless tool is assessed against the applicable EOS charger or low-voltage safety standard as a distinct item.
target_standards: Egyptian Standard (ES) adopting IEC 62841 series for electric motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools
EOS charger or low-voltage safety standard for the charger, external PSU, or adapter where applicable
Egypt mains 220 V 50 Hz plug and marking requirements
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series, which itself is aligned with IEC 62841. The China grid uses 220 V single-phase and 380 V three-phase at 50 Hz, so a Chinese tool already shares the 50 Hz frequency but plug type, rated-voltage marking, and Arabic or bilingual instructions for Egypt still need confirmation.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: Because both GB/T 3883 and the Egyptian ES descend from IEC 62841, the technical safety content is closely aligned, but a China report is not automatically an Egyptian acceptance document. The exporter must map the test report to the specific ES edition EOS recognises, confirm 220 V 50 Hz plug and marking, address the charger as a separate item, and route the file through GOEIC registration and import inspection rather than relying on the GB report alone.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for market access: conformity with the applicable EOS Egyptian Standard (adopting IEC 62841) plus GOEIC registration and import inspection. The charger or external PSU is assessed against the relevant EOS low-voltage or charger safety standard.
target.zh: 市场准入上属实质强制：符合适用的 EOS 埃及标准（采纳 IEC 62841），并完成 GOEIC 注册和进口检验。充电器或外置电源按相关 EOS 低压或充电器安全标准评估。
target.zht: 市場准入上屬實質強制：符合適用的 EOS 埃及標準（採納 IEC 62841），並完成 GOEIC 註冊和進口檢驗。充電器或外置電源按相關 EOS 低壓或充電器安全標準評估。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及适用的充电器专项标准。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及適用的充電器專項標準。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Technically close because both standards derive from IEC 62841, but not Egypt-ready until the report is mapped to the EOS-recognised ES edition, 220 V 50 Hz plug and marking are confirmed, the charger is assessed separately, and the file clears GOEIC registration and import inspection.

source.publisher: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS)

rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven and electronically controlled power tools, their speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies should meet the Egyptian Standards (ES) for electromagnetic compatibility, which commonly adopt the relevant IEC and CISPR families for emission and immunity. EMC evidence is reviewed as part of GOEIC import inspection and registration, and for cordless tools with radio modules the radio EMC aspects connect to NTRA approval.
target_standards: Egyptian Standard (ES) for EMC adopting relevant IEC/CISPR emission and immunity standards
GOEIC import inspection and registration covering EMC evidence
NTRA radio approval for EMC aspects of cordless tools with radio modules
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC test reports based on GB EMC standards alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Test limits, marketed configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger and battery-pack inclusion, and Egypt-specific documentation still need confirmation against the EOS-recognised EMC standard.
china_standards: China GB EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A common gap is an EMC report that tests only the bare tool and omits the charger, battery pack, or electronic-controller variants, or that cites GB limits without mapping to the EOS-recognised EMC standard. The Egypt file should reflect the exact marketed configuration and be presented through GOEIC inspection, with NTRA-relevant radio emissions handled separately for cordless tools.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for in-scope apparatus: conformity with the EOS-recognised EMC standard, evidenced through GOEIC import inspection and registration; radio EMC for cordless tools is tied to NTRA approval.
target.zh: 对适用设备实质强制：符合 EOS 认可的 EMC 标准，并通过 GOEIC 进口检验和注册提供证据；无绳工具的无线电 EMC 与 NTRA 批准挂钩。
target.zht: 對適用設備實質強制：符合 EOS 認可的 EMC 標準，並透過 GOEIC 進口檢驗和註冊提供證據；無繩工具的無線電 EMC 與 NTRA 批准掛鉤。

cn.en: China domestic files may include GB-based EMC evidence, but Egypt acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, and mapping to the EOS-recognised standard.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含基于 GB 的 EMC 证据，但埃及接受性取决于范围、限值、配置及与 EOS 认可标准的映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含基於 GB 的 EMC 證據，但埃及接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置及與 EOS 認可標準的映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Egypt-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system, is mapped to the EOS-recognised EMC standard, clears GOEIC inspection, and any radio EMC for cordless tools is handled through NTRA.

source.publisher: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS)

rows.requirement: Market Access via GOEIC Registration and Import Inspection
rows.target_requirement: Power tools entering Egypt go through the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC). Under the Decree 43/2016 registry, the foreign manufacturer or brand must be registered to export listed consumer products to Egypt, the importer of record must be an Egyptian entity, and shipments undergo GOEIC import inspection against the applicable Egyptian Standards. Products are conformity-checked at entry ports such as Alexandria, Port Said, and Damietta, and EOS standards (often adopting IEC 62841) set the technical baseline.
target_standards: GOEIC importer and foreign-factory registration under Decree 43/2016 registry
GOEIC import inspection against applicable Egyptian Standards (ES)
EOS Egyptian Standards adopting IEC 62841 series as the technical baseline
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held, transportable, and garden tools, with CCC applicable to some categories. GB/T 3883 evidence does not constitute Egyptian market access; it does not replace GOEIC registration, the Egyptian importer of record, port import inspection, or mapping to the recognised ES standard.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Egyptian placement. The exporter and importer need GOEIC foreign-factory or brand registration under the Decree 43/2016 registry, an Egyptian importer of record, an inspection-ready file mapped to the recognised ES standard, Arabic or bilingual marking and instructions, and clearance through GOEIC import inspection at the entry port.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation for market access: GOEIC registration under the Decree 43/2016 registry, an Egyptian importer of record, and GOEIC import inspection against the applicable Egyptian Standards (ES adopting IEC 62841).
target.zh: 市场准入的强制法律义务：按 43/2016 号法令注册制度完成 GOEIC 注册、设立埃及责任进口商，并接受 GOEIC 按适用埃及标准（采纳 IEC 62841 的 ES）的进口检验。
target.zht: 市場准入的強制法律義務：按 43/2016 號法令註冊制度完成 GOEIC 註冊、設立埃及責任進口商，並接受 GOEIC 按適用埃及標準（採納 IEC 62841 的 ES）的進口檢驗。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC for some categories.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，部分类别适用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，部分類別適用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Egypt-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence. GOEIC registration under the Decree 43/2016 registry, an Egyptian importer of record, ES standard mapping, Arabic or bilingual marking, and GOEIC import inspection are required for market access.

source.publisher: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC), Egypt

rows.requirement: Outdoor Noise Marking Status in Egypt
rows.target_requirement: Egypt does not operate an equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise marking regime (the EU guaranteed sound-power marking and conformity assessment under Directive 2000/14/EC). There is no general Egyptian requirement to apply an EU-style outdoor sound-power label or to follow that EU conformity-assessment path for power tools. Where occupational or environmental noise matters in Egypt, it is handled through workplace and environmental rules and any product noise data declared by the manufacturer, not through an EU-style product noise-marking directive.
target_standards: No Egyptian equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise marking for power tools
Egyptian occupational and environmental noise rules where applicable
Manufacturer-declared product noise data where provided
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may include declared noise or vibration data, but does not include an EU-style outdoor sound-power marking. For Egypt this is generally not a barrier because Egypt has no equivalent outdoor-noise marking obligation.
china_standards: China declared noise or vibration data where applicable
rows.gap: Unlike the EU, Egypt imposes no general outdoor-noise product-marking gap for power tools, so the EU-style guaranteed sound-power label is not required for Egyptian market access. The honest position is that this is a low-priority item for Egypt; the exporter should still keep any declared noise data accurate and check sector-specific or tender-specific noise clauses if a buyer or project imposes them.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style outdoor-noise product marking applies to power tools in Egypt. Workplace and environmental noise rules and contract-specific clauses may still apply in context.
target.zh: 埃及对电动工具不适用强制的欧盟式户外噪声产品标识。在具体情形下，职业和环境噪声法规及合同特定条款仍可能适用。
target.zht: 埃及對電動工具不適用強制的歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識。在具體情形下，職業和環境噪聲法規及合同特定條款仍可能適用。

cn.en: GB/T 3883 safety evidence does not include EU-style outdoor-noise marking, which Egypt does not require either.
cn.zh: GB/T 3883 安全证据不包含欧盟式户外噪声标识，而埃及同样不作要求。
cn.zht: GB/T 3883 安全證據不包含歐盟式戶外噪聲標識，而埃及同樣不作要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Low-priority for Egypt: there is no EU-style outdoor-noise marking obligation, so the absence of an EU sound-power label is not an Egyptian market-access gap. Keep any declared noise data accurate and verify contract or sector-specific noise clauses if a buyer imposes them.

source.publisher: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS)

rows.target_requirement: Egypt does not run a single RoHS-style directive identical to the EU one, but restricted-substance and material-safety expectations reach power tools through applicable Egyptian Standards (ES, often adopting IEC content), chemical and environmental rules, and GOEIC import inspection. Documentation showing control of hazardous substances and material safety supports inspection and any sector or buyer requirements, and should be mapped to the ES and rules Egypt actually recognises rather than presented as an EU declaration.
target_standards: Applicable Egyptian Standards (ES) covering material safety, often adopting IEC content
Egyptian chemical and environmental rules where applicable
GOEIC import inspection covering material and labelling evidence
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review. For Egypt this material data is useful supporting evidence but must be mapped to the Egyptian Standards and rules GOEIC recognises rather than treated as an automatic Egyptian acceptance document.
rows.gap: The Egypt gap is less about a single RoHS declaration and more about mapping existing material-safety evidence to the Egyptian Standards and rules GOEIC inspection applies, plus correct Arabic or bilingual labelling. Exporters should keep China RoHS and material data ready as supporting evidence but not assume an EU RoHS declaration satisfies Egyptian inspection.

target.en: Material-safety and restricted-substance expectations apply in practice through applicable Egyptian Standards, chemical and environmental rules, and GOEIC import inspection rather than a single EU-style RoHS directive.
target.zh: 材料安全和限用物质的要求在实务中通过适用的埃及标准、化学和环境法规以及 GOEIC 进口检验适用，而非通过单一的欧盟式 RoHS 指令。
target.zht: 材料安全和限用物質的要求在實務中透過適用的埃及標準、化學和環境法規以及 GOEIC 進口檢驗適用，而非透過單一的歐盟式 RoHS 指令。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 evidence is supporting material but does not automatically satisfy Egyptian inspection requirements.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 证据为支持材料，但不会自动满足埃及检验要求。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 證據為支持材料，但不會自動滿足埃及檢驗要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Egypt-ready until material-safety and restricted-substance evidence is mapped to the recognised Egyptian Standards and rules, supported with correct Arabic or bilingual labelling, and presented through GOEIC import inspection.

source.publisher: Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS)

rows.requirement: Battery and Radio Approval for Cordless Tools
rows.target_requirement: For cordless power tools, the lithium battery pack and charger must meet applicable Egyptian Standards for battery and charger safety and pass GOEIC import inspection, and any cordless tool containing a radio module (such as wireless connectivity) requires NTRA radio-equipment approval before it can be imported and sold in Egypt. Egypt does not impose the EU Battery Regulation passport regime, so the obligations are battery and charger safety plus NTRA radio approval rather than an EU 2023/1542 conformity package.
target_standards: Applicable Egyptian Standards for lithium battery and charger safety
NTRA radio-equipment approval for cordless tools with radio modules
GOEIC import inspection for battery and charger evidence
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, plus separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence such as UN 38.3. This supports the file but does not by itself meet Egyptian battery and charger standards, GOEIC inspection, or NTRA radio approval for cordless tools with radio modules.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety and transport evidence (e.g. UN 38.3) where applicable
rows.gap: Cordless tools need battery and charger safety mapped to Egyptian Standards and cleared through GOEIC inspection, and any radio module requires NTRA approval, which a China domestic or transport test does not cover. The exporter should screen each cordless model for a radio module early, since missing NTRA approval can block import even if the tool safety file is otherwise complete.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for cordless tools: battery and charger safety to applicable Egyptian Standards and GOEIC inspection, plus NTRA radio-equipment approval for any tool with a radio module. There is no EU Battery Regulation passport obligation in Egypt.
target.zh: 对无绳工具实质强制：电池和充电器安全符合适用埃及标准并通过 GOEIC 检验，含无线电模块的工具还须取得 NTRA 无线电设备批准。埃及没有欧盟电池法规护照义务。
target.zht: 對無繩工具實質強制：電池和充電器安全符合適用埃及標準並通過 GOEIC 檢驗，含無線電模組的工具還須取得 NTRA 無線電設備批准。埃及沒有歐盟電池法規護照義務。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence (GB/T 3883 plus UN 38.3) does not automatically satisfy Egyptian battery and charger standards, GOEIC inspection, or NTRA radio approval.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据（GB/T 3883 加 UN 38.3）不会自动满足埃及电池和充电器标准、GOEIC 检验或 NTRA 无线电批准。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據（GB/T 3883 加 UN 38.3）不會自動滿足埃及電池和充電器標準、GOEIC 檢驗或 NTRA 無線電批准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Egypt-ready for cordless tools until battery and charger safety is mapped to Egyptian Standards and cleared through GOEIC inspection, and any radio module obtains NTRA approval. The EU Battery Regulation passport does not apply in Egypt.
